arguments.explanation: Flags transactions above $500 that occurred in June, July or August 2019.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means strictly greater than $500, i.e. amount_usd_cents > 50000.
June, July and August 2019 means 2019-06-01 up to but not including 2019-09-01.
Amounts are in US cents, so $500 is 50000.
